name: Hashira Partners
description: Hashira Partners — a landing-page theme for a small-warehouse leasing brokerage. A black first screen with a two-line headline locked between three full-width rules, a mission line and one outline request pill above a documentary photograph of an agent and an owner in an empty bay; then a white page with a bold statement, a 235 px looping line, full-height case photographs with four caption columns, a stepped-bar buildings archive, ruled prose steps and a black request form. Schibsted Grotesk for headings, Outfit for reading. Black, white and one grey; photographs are the only colour. WCAG AA colours.

fonts.role: display: headings, wordmark, the giant looping line (variable 400-900, Latin)

summary.en: A leasing brokerage landing page: a black ruled two-line headline over a bay photograph, full-height case panels and a stepped-bar buildings archive.
